mapper.sql: select offering_id, semester_id, course_id, teacher_id, campus_id, class_count, max_students, enrolled_count, offering_status, status, del_flag, elastic_enabled, elastic_max, elastic_step, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from tpm_course_offering
mapper.select:
select co.offering_id, co.semester_id, co.course_id, co.teacher_id, co.campus_id, co.class_count, co.max_students, co.offering_status, co.status, co.create_time, co.remark, se.semester_name as semester_name, cl.course_name as course_name, cl.course_code as course_code, cl.credit as credit, t.teacher_name as teacher_name, (select count(1) from tpm_selection_enrollment e where e.course_offering_id = co.offering_id and e.result_status = '1' and e.del_flag = '0') as enrolled_count from tpm_course_offering co left join brm_semester se on co.semester_id = se.semester_id left join tpm_course_library cl on co.course_id = cl.course_id left join brm_teacher t on co.teacher_id = t.teacher_id
co.del_flag = '0' and co.semester_id = #{semesterId} and co.course_id = #{courseId} and co.offering_status = #{offeringStatus} and co.status = #{status} and cl.course_name like concat('%', #{courseName}, '%')
and t.teacher_name like concat('%', #{teacherName}, '%')
order by co.offering_id asc
select distinct course_id from tpm_course_offering where del_flag = '0' and offering_status <> '2' and semester_id = #{semesterId}
select teacher_id from brm_teacher where status = '0' and dept_id = #{deptId} order by teacher_id
mapper.insert:
insert into tpm_course_offering
semester_id, course_id, teacher_id, campus_id, class_count, max_students, offering_status, status, elastic_enabled, elastic_max, elastic_step, create_by, create_time, remark,
#{semesterId}, #{courseId}, #{teacherId}, #{campusId}, #{classCount}, #{maxStudents}, #{offeringStatus}, #{status}, #{elasticEnabled}, #{elasticMax}, #{elasticStep}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark},
mapper.update: update tpm_course_offering set enrolled_count = enrolled_count + 1, update_time = sysdate() where offering_id = #{offeringId} and del_flag = '0' and enrolled_count < max_students
update tpm_course_offering set enrolled_count = enrolled_count - 1, update_time = sysdate() where offering_id = #{offeringId} and enrolled_count > 0

update tpm_course_offering set enrolled_count = (select count(1) from tpm_selection_enrollment e where e.course_offering_id = tpm_course_offering.offering_id and e.result_status = '1' and e.del_flag = '0'), update_time = sysdate() where offering_id in #{offeringId}
update tpm_course_offering set del_flag = '2' where offering_id = #{offeringId}
update tpm_course_offering set del_flag = '2' where offering_id in #{offeringId}
mapper.insert:
insert into tpm_course_offering (semester_id, course_id, teacher_id, campus_id, class_count, max_students, offering_status, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values
(#{item.semesterId}, #{item.courseId}, #{item.teacherId}, #{item.campusId}, #{item.classCount}, #{item.maxStudents}, #{item.offeringStatus}, #{item.status}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.remark})
mapper.select: select o.offering_id as offeringId, o.course_id as courseId, o.teacher_id as teacherId, o.campus_id as campusId, o.class_count as classCount, o.max_students as maxStudents, cl.course_name as courseName, cl.total_hours as totalHours, cl.practice_hours as practiceHours, t.teacher_name as teacherName from tpm_course_offering o left join tpm_course_library cl on o.course_id = cl.course_id left join brm_teacher t on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id where o.del_flag = '0' and o.status = '0' and o.offering_status = '1' and o.semester_id = #{semesterId} and not exists ( select 1 from tpm_schedule s where s.offering_id = o.offering_id and s.del_flag = '0' ) order by o.max_students desc, o.offering_id asc

select o.offering_id as offeringId, o.course_id as courseId, o.teacher_id as teacherId, o.campus_id as campusId, o.class_count as classCount, o.max_students as maxStudents, cl.course_name as courseName, cl.total_hours as totalHours, cl.practice_hours as practiceHours, t.teacher_name as teacherName from tpm_course_offering o left join tpm_course_library cl on o.course_id = cl.course_id left join brm_teacher t on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id where o.del_flag = '0' and o.offering_id in #{id} order by o.max_students desc, o.offering_id asc

select o.offering_id as offeringId, cl.course_name as courseName, t.teacher_name as teacherName, o.max_students as maxStudents, (select count(1) from tpm_selection_enrollment e where e.course_offering_id = o.offering_id and e.round_id = #{roundId} and e.result_status = '1' and e.del_flag = '0') as enrolled, (select count(1) from tpm_selection_enrollment e where e.course_offering_id = o.offering_id and e.round_id = #{roundId} and e.result_status = '2' and e.waitlist_rank is not null and e.del_flag = '0') as waitlisted from tpm_course_offering o left join tpm_course_library cl on o.course_id = cl.course_id left join brm_teacher t on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id where o.del_flag = '0' and exists (select 1 from tpm_selection_enrollment e3 where e3.course_offering_id = o.offering_id and e3.round_id = #{roundId} and e3.del_flag = '0') order by enrolled desc, o.offering_id asc
